agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/others.py SpacesAroundOperatorsFilter._process: an inverted condition (`!=` instead of `==` when checking if the token following an operator is whitespace) caused missing spaces after operators directly touching the next token (e.g. 'foo+100' -> 'foo +100') and doubled spaces when whitespace already existed (e.g. 'foo = bar' -> 'foo =  bar'). Changed `if not (next_ and next_.ttype != T.Whitespace):` to `if not (next_ and next_.ttype == T.Whitespace):`. Verified fix resolves basic, boolean, and nested operator spacing cases without breaking previously working formatting (AND/OR/BETWEEN keywords, string concatenation ||, comparisons, arithmetic, parenthesized expressions).
